## Corrected partial result and remaining gap

Add the complete corrected report, detailed free-germ companion, independent mathematical audit and explicit repair ledger for 30005651 / OWR-14297741-001, rank 1205. Status remains **UNRESOLVED, 1/5 approaches used**. Acceptance is limited to the corrected partial results.

The report establishes a general dimension bound and field-orbit connectivity, an exact subgroup restriction/localization comparison, known stabilizer 1/C2 cases, free-germ connectivity over infinite perfect fields (or with separably generated quotient residue), and local connectivity on the punctured standard S3 representation over C. It also proves the tangent/codimension restriction for a specified smooth finite-support presentation format.

The S3 origin, the general finite-group theorem, and all free germs over arbitrary imperfect fields remain unresolved. No negative stalk class, connectivity counterexample, global-section connectivity theorem, or novelty certificate is asserted.

## Explicit repair and source attribution

The earlier punctured proof tested points only of the base representation before invoking small-site conservativity. The corrected proof tests **every point of every equivariant etale U over the punctured representation**. Geometric inertia embeds in the stabilizer of the nonzero image vector; the free-germ and self-normalizing C2 cases cover every required test. The correction is implemented in both reports. Two additional edits specify affine transition maps in continuity and essentially-etale localization in the coefficient-field construction.

The repair ledger states each original defect, the implemented correction and the unchanged acceptance limits. The original wording is not accepted unconditionally. The complete corrected main argument, companion proof and substantive full-chain audit are retained. A separate explicit scope edit narrows the companion's nonessential closed-point warning to the ordinary Nisnevich-sheaf counterexample actually proved in the main report, removing the stronger A1-local spectral warning. This does not alter the core theorems or original corrected-partial acceptance. Administrative bindings, computational-record descriptions and out-of-edition references are also adapted or omitted.

The rank-one tangent obstruction is credited to [Heller--Voineagu--Ostvaer (2015)](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/26271). [Bachmann's C2 theorem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08125v2), [Morel's ordinary stable-connectivity theorem](https://fangzhoujin.github.io/Morel_The%20stable%20A1-connectivity%20theorems.pdf), and the exact public topology and henselian-algebra sources are credited inputs. The [Sandeep--Sawant preprint](https://mathweb.tifr.res.in/~asawant/GP.pdf) is stated only under its abelian and root-of-unity hypotheses. The [Belfiori seminar announcement](https://indico.math.cnrs.fr/event/17487/) is not treated as a complete inspected theorem.

AI-assisted and unrefereed. No external human peer review, proof-assistant certification, exhaustive present-day literature status or original-discovery claim is asserted.

## Repository and distribution boundary

Exactly ten files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005651/`. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated record or historical turn count changes. Edition preparation adds no proof-search turn.

Only authored mathematics, scoped audits and acceptance, repair history, and public bibliographic verification metadata are included. Source copies, text extracts, images, datasets, private material, frozen inventories, scripts, checkers, standalone computation results/logs and identities of excluded artifacts are omitted. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is part of this change.

## Preparation checks

The original accepted input hashes and zero-fuzz correction replay were verified. Exact editorial differences, byte-preserved mathematical blocks, six public PDF identities, manifest, UTF-8/JSON, relative links and excluded-material scans were checked. The addition-only patch passed strict-whitespace clean replay with exact paths and bytes. The complete pinned base tree chain was freshly read and independently rehashed; all unrelated entries, including the QUEUE blob, are preserved. These are packaging checks, not a further mathematical certification or a CI claim. Exact-head remote readback is a separate publication check.

Base: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
